interventions.description: Install a high-visibility marked crosswalk with a raised pedestrian refuge island in the center median to break up the crossing distance.

interventions.title: Lane Narrowing and Buffer
interventions.description: Reduce the width of travel lanes to slow traffic and use the reclaimed space for a landscaped buffer or bike lane.

interventions.title: Daylighting
interventions.description: Remove parking spaces immediately adjacent to the intersection to improve sight lines for both drivers and pedestrians.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Lighting
interventions.description: Install street lighting to improve visibility and safety for pedestrians during low-light conditions.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Midblock Crosswalk
interventions.description: Install a marked crosswalk with high-visibility paint and pedestrian crossing signage.

interventions.title: Speed Tables
interventions.description: Introduce vertical traffic calming measures to physically slow vehicle speeds along this straight stretch.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Midblock Crossing
interventions.description: Install a marked crosswalk with appropriate signage to provide a safe and legal crossing point along this long stretch of road.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Buffer Strip
interventions.description: Add a vegetated buffer or furniture zone between the sidewalk and the curb to increase the physical and psychological distance from traffic.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Install marked crosswalks with appropriate signage and curb ramps to facilitate safe crossing of the roadway.

interventions.title: Road Diet and Lane Narrowing
interventions.description: Reduce the number or width of travel lanes to include a buffered bike lane, which would also act as a buffer for pedestrians.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Expansion
interventions.description: Construct a standard-width sidewalk on the right side of the road to provide a continuous and safe pedestrian path.
